method: For each candidate action, optimize its relative score by assigning +192 to its feature class and -192 to other classes, with guarded actions fixed at zero. For guarded candidates assign every unguarded class -192. Native first-enumerated ties and immediate-victory action restriction are retained. This exactly tests individual-root reachability with arbitrary bounded feature lookup corrections.
scope: An optimistic lower bound on internal single-batch teacher regret, separately choosing a different mapping for every root. It does not establish one globally consistent model, learnability from data, held-out generalization, true action quality, game strength or X16 feasibility. Original grouped held-out roots became development data in the separate v2 coverage-repair plan.
